title: Produce a complete sales handoff
prompt:
Discovery notes: project=Stockroom; decision owner=Maya; budget=unknown; target=2026-12-01; next step=demo; next-step owner=Ravi. Convert only these facts into a handoff.

Return only one JSON object with exactly these fields. project, decision_owner, target_date, next_step, next_step_owner: strings; budget_cents: integer or null for unknown.
remediation_hints: Preserve unknowns and name who owns the next action.
